review_candidates.title: Configuration Management Specialist
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Configuration Management Specialist Job Category: Engineering and Technical Support Time Type: Full time Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret Employee Type: Regular Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% Type of Travel: Local * * * The Opportunity Join a team responsible for maintaining the integrity, accuracy, and governance of a large-scale enterprise technology environment supporting critical global missions. As a Configuration Management Specialist, you will play a key role in establishing and maintaining configuration baselines, managing change across enterprise systems, and ensuring hardware, software, and configuration data remain accurate throughout the technology lifecycle. These roles require multiple experience levels—from professionals beginning their careers in configuration management to senior technical leaders responsible for enterprise configuration strategy and governance. Successful candidates will collaborate with engineering, operations, cybersecurity, and service management teams to improve configuration accuracy, support controlled system changes, and maintain reliable configuration data that enables secure and efficient IT operations. If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, improving operational processes, and ensuring enterprise environments remain accurate and compliant, you'll find meaningful opportunities to make an impact while supporting mission-critical operations. These opportunities are contingent upon contract award Responsibilities Depending on experience and level, responsibilities may include: Maintain hardware, software, and configuration records throughout the enterprise technology lifecycle. Develop, maintain, and enforce configuration management processes, standards, and documentation. Maintain configuration baselines, logical system relationships, and enterprise configuration data. Support Configuration Management Database (CMDB) administration and ensure the accuracy of configuration items (CIs) and their relationships. Track hardware and software assets, software license assignments, maintenance agreements, warranties, and lifecycle status using ServiceNow or other enterprise management platforms. Monitor and document infrastructure changes across physical, virtual, and cloud environments. Prepare and coordinate change requests, impact analyses, implementation plans, and supporting documentation for Change Advisory Board (CAB) or Change Control Board (CCB) review. Perform configuration audits, asset reconciliations, and compliance reviews to ensure enterprise configuration accuracy. Develop and maintain topology diagrams, system documentation, standard operating procedures, and configuration standards. Partner with Service Desk, Infrastructure, Engineering, Asset Management, and Cybersecurity teams to maintain accurate configuration and operational data. Analyze configuration trends, identify process improvement opportunities, and develop reporting and performance metrics. Support DevSecOps initiatives through configuration management practices and integration with automated deployment pipelines. Senior-level professionals may lead enterprise configuration governance, mentor junior staff, establish configuration policies, and oversee configuration management strategy across multiple programs. Required Qualifications Qualifications vary based on position level. High School diploma with relevant experience or bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Active Secret security clearance Experience supporting IT configuration management, systems administration, enterprise operations, asset management, or infrastructure support. Familiarity with configuration management principles, change management processes, and configuration baselines. Experience maintaining technical documentation, system inventories, and configuration records. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Experience using Microsoft Office applications. Ability to obtain and maintain any required Government security clearance. Desired Qualifications Experience administering or supporting ServiceNow CMDB, Asset Management, Discovery, or IT Service Management (ITSM) modules. Experience with enterprise Configuration Management Databases (CMDBs). Familiarity with ITIL configuration, asset, and change management best practices. Experience preparing documentation and presentations for Change Advisory Boards (CAB) or Change Control Boards (CCB). Knowledge of hardware and software lifecycle management, software licensing, and asset reconciliation. Experience with infrastructure discovery tools and configuration compliance reporting. Familiarity with hybrid enterprise environments, including on-premises and cloud infrastructure. Experience with automation and DevSecOps technologies such as Ansible, Terraform, Git, CI/CD pipelines, SonarQube, or related tools. Experience supporting Federal Government or Department of State enterprise IT environments. Relevant certifications such as ITIL Foundation, ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA), ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS), CompTIA Security+, or other configuration management, cloud, or systems administration certifications. This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI. What You Can Expect A culture of integrity. At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation. An environment of trust. CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality. A focus on continuous growth. Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy. Pay Range There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits. The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is $84,900 - $178,400 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

review_candidates.title: Assistant Support Technician
review_candidates.description: Job Overview University Hospital Southampton NHS Foundation Trust is delighted to offer a fantastic opportunity to work with us. Please see below for detailed job description of the role. This vacancy does not meet the Home Office threshold for sponsorship; therefore we are unable to accept applications from candidates who do not have the right to work in the UK. Main duties of the job As part of our team, you will provide support to end users across the trust and our external partners and respond to issues via the service desk portal, phone, and face to face visits. This is part of the 2nd line support team responding to user issues, requests and queries for our clinical and non-clinical systems. We are looking for a Assistant Support Technician. You will work with a variety of teams across UHS Digital but also closely with hospital administration and clinical teams to ensure the best care for our patients. The team work between 8am and 6pm with team members working either 8 - 4 or 10 - 6 shifts between Monday - Friday and the successful candidate will be consulted on what fits both them and the needs of the service. Working for our organisation As one of the largest acute teaching Trusts in England, we offer learning and development opportunities to help you achieve the career you aspire to. UHS is rated ‘Good’ by the CQC and in the latest national NHS Staff Survey, we were in the top 10 acute trusts for staff engagement and for staff recommending the hospital as a place to work or receive care. We support flexible working and will consider requests taking into account the needs of the service. UHS employees are able to access a range of NHS discounts, are entitled to a minimum of 35 days paid holiday (pro rata), and we offer a generous pension scheme. Southampton is an attractive place to live and work situated on the south coast, with an international airport and direct trains to London. The New Forest National Park and beaches of the Jurassic coast are also right on our doorstep. The city offers living costs 30% lower than London and 17 schools rated outstanding by Ofsted. We believe that using technology wisely shows strong time management and commitment to innovation. However, personalising your recruitment application to highlight your unique skills and experiences is crucial. Relying too heavily on generic, AI-generated content instead of drawing from your own strengths and accomplishments may lead to your application being rejected if multiple candidates present identical or similar information. Detailed Job Description And Main Responsibilities In this role, your key responsibilities will include: Diagnose, troubleshoot, and provide user support for digital systems Responsible for core applications and for providing second line support for these at a specialist level, including configuration changes and data corrections Respond in accordance with service level agreements to all calls forwarded by the Trust ITService Desk. Ensure unplanned systems outages or unavailability is communicated to stakeholders providing regular updates. Work in partnership with all other support teams to form good working links across thedepartment. Undertake any other task consistent with grade and experience as determined by line manager or senior manager within UHS Digital. For an overview of the position, please refer to the attached Job Description and Person Specification document. This includes a detailed breakdown of the key responsibilities, role expectations, and the qualifications we are looking for. Person specification Qualifications, Knowledge And Experience Essential criteria Level 4 NVQ or Diploma or equivalent experience Understanding of what it means to deliver good customer service Good all-round understanding of information technology Proficient MS Office user (up to and including M365) Experience with troubleshooting and solving problems Knowledge and understanding of the importance of data protection Experience of collaborating or working in a team Desirable criteria Previous experience as a user of complex digital systems Recognised IT qualification Knowledge of hospital patient flows Relevant experience of database administration / maintenance Basic knowledge of SQL Basic knowledge of any programming language(s) Previous experience of working in an IT Support service Trust Values and Behaviours Essential criteria Patients First Always Improving Working Together
